Set task-design principles
real-world yet conceptually simple for humans
non-gameable · concise unique factoid answer

Select stable evidence sources
trusted web pages · attached files · puzzles
images, spreadsheets, PDFs, audio or video

Human authors craft each question
paper authors plus paid Surge annotators
combine sources and required assistant skills

Author records the reference package
short answer · tools · steps · estimated time
dated/versioned web evidence where needed

Two new annotators answer independently
validate only when all three answers agree
check evidence access, wording, and ambiguity

Repair disagreements or remove the item
68% accepted without correction
about 2 human-hours per retained question

Assign one of three difficulty levels
L1: ≤1 tool and ≤5 steps · L2: ~5–10 steps
L3: long sequences and unrestricted tool mix

Assemble 466 validated questions
developer set: 166 with annotations
test set: 300 questions with hidden answers

Run a zero-shot general assistant
reason, browse, code, and use tools as needed
return the answer in the required final format

Normalize by ground-truth answer type
apply quasi-exact short-answer matching
report accuracy by level and overall
